comment: The game's HDRP asset settings that HDRP's build stripper selects compute shader variants by. Read from the running game (MCP get_status > managed.renderPipeline.hdrp) on 2026-11-11, game version 2.28.3, Unity 2023.2.22f1, one quality level. If the game changes them, the kernels of the other combination are missing: update this file and rebuild the bundle (scripts/build-hdrp-bundle.ps1).
